title: Etale cohomology of a strictly henselian local scheme vanishes in positive degrees
statement: Let $R$ be a strictly henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] and $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then the global sections functor $\Gamma(S,-):\Ab(S_{\Et})\to\textit{Ab}$ on abelian sheaves on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] is exact, and $H^p(S_{\Et},\mathcal F)=0$ for every $\mathcal F\in\Ab(S_{\Et})$ and every $p\ge1$ (etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]).

source.place: Lemma Tag 03QO (lemma-vanishing-etale-cohomology-strictly-henselian, line 8207), the final assertion and the last sentence of its proof ('the higher derived functors of an exact functor are zero'); the exactness via Gamma(S, F) = F_sbar is [lem-weil-pbc-strictly-henselian-sections-stalk]
